title: fix: route Qwen3 VL 30B Instruct through DeepInfra
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Qwen3 VL 30B A3B Instruct is pinned to OpenRouter’s DeepInfra FP8 route after the Alibaba endpoint was dropped and requests began failing on 2026-10-09. There is no fallback; the canonical model name and `qwen-vision` alias remain unchanged, and the model remains paid-only. DeepInfra’s higher rate is billed per 1M input and output tokens. Local provider checks returned 200 for all nine requests across text, streaming, tool calls, JSON output, short outputs and vision; vision readback missed one character in two of four checks. Staging pack-meter charges matched the updated rate.
